items.name: narration_en
items.direction: Narrate this as a popular science and geography YouTube Shorts channel. The Narrator is a deep, warm, confident storyteller: brisk and curious, with natural emphasis and a short comic pause before each punchline. Chars voices funny cartoon characters, short and punchy.
lines: Narrator
What you're seeing isn't a trick shot.
Narrator
This car weighs almost one point seven tonnes, and it's stopped upside down.
Narrator
No magnets. No glue. So what's holding it up?
Narrator
This October, Tesla drove its new Roadster up a curved ramp... and stopped.
Chars
[grumpy, heavy, deep, slow cartoon planet-sized voice, baffled, straining like pulling a rope] Excuse me? I'm pulling. Nothing's happening.
Narrator
Here's the trick. Air is heavy.
Narrator
Every square metre around you carries about ten tonnes of air. Roughly two elephants.
Narrator
But the Roadster's four fans suck the air out from under it.
Narrator
Less air below, same air outside. So the air pins it to the road... even upside down.
Narrator
How hard? Tesla claims about four thousand seven hundred kilos. Nearly three times the car's weight.
Chars
[grumpy, heavy, deep, slow cartoon planet-sized voice, deeply offended] Nearly three to one? Rude.
Narrator
But Tesla didn't invent this. Rewind to nineteen seventy-eight.
Narrator
A Formula One car raced in Sweden with a giant fan on its back.
Chars
[nervous 1970s racing mechanic, too innocent, quick, fake casual] It's for cooling the engine. Honest.
Narrator
It won its only race by over half a minute. Then fan cars got banned.
Narrator
So the Roadster isn't beating gravity. It's turning the sky against it.
Narrator
And to come down? It flies. ... Sort of.
Narrator
Ten thrusters, built with SpaceX, blast out six hundred litres of squeezed air.
Narrator
It hopped over five Teslas, rolled in mid-air and landed. Nobody inside.
Narrator
Tesla says production starts in twenty twenty-eight. First promised: twenty twenty.
Chars
[grumpy, heavy, deep, slow cartoon planet-sized voice, deadpan, very patient] Take your time. I'll be here.
Narrator
This is Bhoogol. Follow for more Geography Fun Facts.
